storyCards.headline: Hungry Like The Wolf: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Duran Duran's "Hungry Like The Wolf" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 23 weeks on the chart.

Hungry Like The Wolf was released in 1984.
